rounds.text: Misquita Engineering Ltd trades at an extraordinary valuation that is completely disconnected from its actual financial delivery, carrying a heavy price-to-earnings ratio of 172x [E1] and 169.18x against a sector benchmark of just 66.66x [E6]. This lofty pricing is paired with an exceptionally weak return on assets of 0% compared to a sector benchmark of 4.17% [E8], alongside a stagnant return on equity of 1.7% [E13] and a dismal 3-year median ROE of 0% [E27]. Profitability momentum is actively deteriorating, evidenced by a compounded 3-year profit growth rate of -18% [E20] and earnings growth that is officially flagged as decelerating [E67]. Furthermore, long-term returns remain persistently depressed, with a 10-year median ROE of only 4% [E25] and a 3-year average flagged as low at 0.48% [E58], yielding a 0.00% dividend for investors [E4]. Conceded: the company demonstrates recent top-line momentum with sales up 93% YoY and multi-year sales uptrends [E62, E65].
